The 2027 Bullet Crossfire 245RKS Is Half-Ton Towable, Value-Oriented, and Oh So Nice
20 photos
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report
Just because something is described as value-oriented or budget-friendly doesn't mean that it's cheap in the worst sense of the word. The Bullet Crossfire travel trailer from Keystone RV is the perfect example of that in the RV segment.
Keystone's Bullet series of travel trailers was launched as just that: value-oriented products that ticked several boxes, including towability, comfort, and even extended autonomy. Over the years, Keystone further refined the series, dividing it into three layers depending on the degree of comfort and spec they offered.
The Bullet Crossfire is the mid-tier Bullet, itself divided into several floorplans. The Bullet Crossfire 245RKS is one of the most popular in the series, a rear kitchen floorplan that offers sleeping for as many as six people, and all the creature comforts of home. The best part is that it does all this without breaking the bank.
For the 2027 model year, Keystone is further upgrading and refining the Bullet, introducing for the Crossfire sub-series a new exterior, an upgraded interior with new cabinetry and hardware, and better tech.
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report As you can see in the overly enthusiastic video tour at the bottom of the page, this allows the 2027 Bullet Crossfire 245RKS to go from a value-oriented travel trailer to a nice family option that might even be capable of some mild boondocking.
Construction is the same as with the other Bullets, and that means no wood, all-composite shell with HyperCore sidewalls under a layer of fiberglass, HyperDeck composite flooring, a fully walkable roof, and a redesigned molded fiberglass front cap that will definitely get some eyeballs at camp. Getting attention must be last on the list of priorities when buying a new RV, but nice aesthetics do matter.
The Bullet Crossfire 245RKS comes in at 28.8 feet (8.7 meters) of total length and rides on a tandem axle equipped with Lippert Road Armor suspension and Goodyear tires.
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report Standard spec includes a power tongue jack with a hardcover box for a pair of propane tanks, power stabilizer jacks, solid composite entry steps with adjustable legs, and Solar Flex standard that gets you a 220W of solar on the roof (upgradable to 660W), a 30-amp Victron controller, prep for a 2000W inverter, and seven inverted outlets onboard.
This floorplan is a two-door, single-slide one, which makes it perfect for traveling families as it offers the right amount of space and privacy to co-exist even for longer stretches. To that same end, it uses a pass-through mid bathroom, while making room onboard for a dedicated dining space and storage for all six people.
One entrances is directly into the front bedroom, while the other gives into the rear kitchen and open-plan living room. A large 12V fridge with freezer and Thomas Payne theater seats that you can swap out for a tri-fold sofa to get that six-person sleeping capacity occupy the single slide-out, which is flush-floor for maximum comfort.
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report The rear kitchen takes up the entire width at the back, so it's a single-block one. Still, it's nicely appointed and spacious enough to allow even two cooks working side by side, with a three-burner gas cooktop, an RV-size oven, a Furrion extractor, and a Furrion microwave with air fryer function.
Keystone boasts the tallest height in its class for the Bullet, which means 82 inches (208 cm) f headroom, which, in turn, means you get extra storage in overhead cabinets. For good measure, the kitchen also offers under-the-counter storage, but you have the possibility to extend kitchen storage in the dinette or overhead in the slide.
Cabinets come with strong magnetic latches and either latticed or glass-like faces, which saves weight and money without feeling as if it's a compromise.
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report The booth-style dinette converts into a third bed and offers a 32-inch 12V TV on a swivel overhead, perfectly positioned for viewing from the theater seats in the slide-out. Also here, you get a pantry and a full wardrobe across the way, with an electric fireplace added for the atmosphere and as an extra heat source.
The bathroom is a standard pass-through one, but finished with the same residential touches , proving that, indeed, it's the little things that make a difference. You get a shower with a full fiberglass surround, an extra-high skylight, and a squeegee door, a porcelain foot-flush toilet, and a sink on a vanity that actually offers ample storage wherever possible.
Two barn doors on either side of the bathroom allow for much-needed privacy. You can close off the main bedroom and create some separation between those sleeping here and the four guests in the front part of the trailer.
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report Speaking of the bedroom, it comes with a true queen bed on an aluminum-slatted base with extra storage and gas struts for each access, overhead cabinets, matching wardrobes, and accent lights.
The Bullet Crossfire 245RKS comes with a best-in-class 18,000-BTU Furrion Chill Cube AC in the living room space, a second 8,000-BTU unit in the bedroom, ducted furnace, an on-demand water heater, and oversize holding tanks. That means 54 gallons (204 liters) of freshwater, 76 gallons (287 liters) of gray, and 38 gallons (144 liters) of black water.
Another advantage of this floorplan is the fact that it's manageable in size and half-ton towable. Empty weight is listed at 6,115 lbs (2,774 kg), with 7,600 lbs (3,447 kg) of gross weight.
Photo: YouTube/Field and Sports Report The 2027 Keystone Bullet Crossfire 245RKS is selling for prices ranging $34,000-$42,000, depending on options and the dealer you get your unit from. It's not "cheap," but it is good value for everything it offers .
Via // Field and Sports Report
